title: Release readiness
description: Can this ship, can it be undone, and will people know what changed.

criteria.title: All gates green on the release commit
criteria.ask: Typecheck, lint, tests, build, audit and any end-to-end checks pass on exactly what will be tagged?
criteria.evidence: The commit hash and each gate's result.

criteria.title: Rollback is known and tried
criteria.ask: If it goes wrong in production, what do you do, how long does it take, and has anyone rehearsed it?
criteria.evidence: The rollback steps and the outcome of rehearsing them.

criteria.title: Changelog tells the truth
criteria.ask: Does every user-visible change, breaking change and migration appear, and does nothing appear that did not ship?
criteria.evidence: The changelog compared with the commit list.

criteria.title: Version matches the change
criteria.ask: Is the version bump right for what changed (breaking, feature, fix)?

criteria.title: Upgrade path documented
criteria.ask: What must an existing user do, and is it automated or at least checked?
criteria.evidence: The upgrade notes, and the result of upgrading from the previous version.

criteria.title: You will see problems
criteria.ask: Logs, alerts and a smoke test after deploy?
criteria.evidence: The signals and the post-deploy check.

criteria.title: Published artifact is right
criteria.ask: Does the package or image contain exactly the intended files, and does a clean install of it run?
criteria.evidence: The pack listing and an install-and-run test.
